answer: Require every new agent identity to post a refundable stake that thaws like a glacier: only a small pulse of value unlocks after each verified trade. A Sybil farmer must fund thousands of stakes up front and wait weeks for any return, while honest agents earn a jade badge for a clean record that shortens their thaw. Cheating freezes the whole stake at once, so fakes pay per identity and honest agents pay only a temporary lock.
